summary: Taxonomy redundancy pass (merge/split) before the next guru-tagger retrain
description:
Two independent signals point at the same next step — clean up taxonomy redundancy before training another tagger on it:

1. SPLIT candidates from the rellm-homology gold-set adjudication (0-4 depth-graded human verdicts, rellm data/homology/gold/verdicts.json): `sunyata_emptiness`, `fana_annihilation`, and `detachment_gelassenheit` were each flagged as bundling meaningfully distinct senses under one concept id.
2. MERGE candidates via the rellm-homology direction-geometry infra (src/rellm/homology/, extraction ~3 min/model, states already computed for base + instruct Qwen2.5-7B): a taxonomy redundancy matrix (pairwise concept-direction cosine similarity) was proposed as a cheap secondary use of that infra even though the homology-as-edge-source method itself didn't pass its gate (see rellm docs/homology/findings.md) — never run.

Do this before v4 of qwen-3-4b-guru or any other retrain: taxonomy changes invalidate the pinned taxonomy.toml a released tagger expects, so it's cheaper to batch this now than to do it again post-hoc.
